gene_list.description: ACMG Secondary Findings v3.2 actionable genes (2023). ~73 genes covering hereditary cancer, cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia, aortic disease, familial hypercholesterolaemia, and other actionable Mendelian conditions.

exon_coordinates.source: PLACEHOLDER — pending real GENCODE v44 MANE Select replacement
exon_coordinates.description: Each gene has 8 deterministic placeholder exons: start = canonical_chromosome_start + (exon_index * 1200), length 150 bp. Chromosome starts are from training knowledge (GRCh38). Real GENCODE v44 MANE Select coordinates must be substituted before any live mosdepth coverage run (Phase 3 prerequisite). See work-notes.md for the replacement procedure.
exon_coordinates.transcript_filter_intended: MANE Select where present; GENCODE canonical otherwise
exon_coordinates.placeholder_warning: DO NOT use for clinical interpretation. Per-exon coverage numbers will not align with real genomic positions until real GENCODE coordinates are substituted.

curation_notes: Union of ACMG SF v3.2, GenomeClaw five disease-area sysprompt panels, and PharmCAT-flagged pharmacogenomic genes. Deduplicated: APOE appears in both cardiovascular and neurodegeneration panels and is counted once. PTEN, MUTYH, PCSK9 appear in both ACMG and disease-area panels; counted once.
